name: Yellowstone National Park
description: Yellowstone, mostly in northwest Wyoming and spilling into Montana and Idaho, is widely considered the world's first national park, founded in 1872. It sits atop a dormant supervolcano whose heat powers more than 300 geysers, including Old Faithful, plus thousands of other steaming pools and vents. Bison, wolves and grizzly bears roam its forests, lakes and canyons.
